1200: Tam Chuc is the world's largest pagoda by area. We cross the lake on a boat styled as an ancient one, walk through the garden of 99 stone pillars carved with Buddhist sutras and see three huge bronze Buddha statues. Optional — the Perfume Pagoda in the caves of the Huong mountains, the country's main pilgrimage site.
